question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 50,000. Of three shopkeepers, the first one allows two successive discounts of 25% and 15%.The second one allows two successive discounts 20% and 20%. The third shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 30% and 10%. From which shopkeeper does the customer get more profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.50000

**Formula used:**

Effective discount = D₁ + D₂ - (D1 × D2)/100

**Calculation:**

First case:

D1 = 25% and D2 = 15%

Effective discount = 25 + 15 - (25 × 15)/100

⇒ 40 - 3.75 = 36.25%

Second case:

D1 = 20% and D2 = 20%

Effective discount = 20 + 20 - (20 × 20)/100

⇒ 40 - 4 = 36%

Third case:

D1 = 30% and D2 = 10%

Effective discount = 30 + 10 - (30 × 10)/100

⇒ 40 - 3 = 37%

**∴ The correct option is 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Calculation:- 

First Shopkeeper:

Marked price of the article: Rs. 50,000

First discount: 25%

Calculation: Rs. 50,000 - (25% of Rs. 50,000) = Rs. 50,000 - Rs. 12,500 = Rs. 37,500

Second discount: 15%

Calculation: Rs. 37,500 - (15% of Rs. 37,500) = Rs. 37,500 - Rs. 5,625 = Rs. 31,875

Final price offered by the first shopkeeper: Rs. 31,875

Second Shopkeeper:

Marked price of the article: Rs. 50,000

First discount: 20%

Calculation: Rs. 50,000 - (20% of Rs. 50,000) = Rs. 50,000 - Rs. 10,000 = Rs. 40,000

Second discount: 20%

Calculation: Rs. 40,000 - (20% of Rs. 40,000) = Rs. 40,000 - Rs. 8,000 = Rs. 32,000

Final price offered by the second shopkeeper: Rs. 32,000

Third Shopkeeper:

Marked price of the article: Rs. 50,000

First discount: 30%

Calculation: Rs. 50,000 - (30% of Rs. 50,000) = Rs. 50,000 - Rs. 15,000 = Rs. 35,000

Second discount: 10%

Calculation: Rs. 35,000 - (10% of Rs. 35,000) = Rs. 35,000 - Rs. 3,500 = Rs. 31,500

Final price offered by the third shopkeeper: Rs. 31,500

First shopkeeper: Rs. 31875

Second shopkeeper: Rs. 32000

Third shopkeeper: Rs. 31500

**From the above calculations, the customer gets the most profit from the third shopkeeper, where the final price is Rs. 31,500. Therefore, the correct answer is 3) Third.**
